0022600127.text: The Nuggets, playing their third game of the season, are 1-1 overall and 1-0 at home, on a W1 streak, sitting 7th in the West and 4th in the Northwest, 1.5 games back, while the Warriors are 0-3 on a three-game losing streak, 15th in the West and 5th in the Pacific, 3 games back. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and Denver's most recent meeting was a 116-93 home win on March 29, 2026, with no games between them yet in 2026-27. Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), who are both out, and Alpha Diallo (wrist) and Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain) are day-to-day and game-time decisions; Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Brandon Williams (back soreness), Charles Bassey (knee), and Gui Santos (knee tendinitis) are day-to-day and game-time decisions.
